raw_action:
import pyautogui, time

# 1. Click into the editor to ensure focus
pyautogui.click(500, 300)
time.sleep(0.5)

# 2. Go to line 2
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'g')
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.typewrite('2')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.5)

# 3. Select the entire line 2, then extend selection down to line 10
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'l')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.keyDown('shift')
for _ in range(8):  # 8 more lines: 3,4,...,10
    pyautogui.press('down')
    time.sleep(0.1)
pyautogui.keyUp('shift')
time.sleep(0.2)

# 4. Indent selected lines by one tab
pyautogui.press('tab')
